prompt: A cosy garden landscape layer for a mobile game, in exactly the same art style as the reference images: soft flat 2D illustration, gentle cel shading, no outlines, soft pastel palette of lavender, mint green, warm gold and cream. Straight-on view. The horizon sits about 40 percent down from the top: along it, soft rounded lavender hills in the distance and a line of fluffy rounded green bushes. Below the horizon, a wide open soft green meadow fills the lower 60 percent, with a gentle winding sandy path coming from the bottom centre toward the middle, a few small wildflowers, one rounded leafy tree cut off at the far left edge, and a small tree stump with two red-and-white mushrooms near the right edge. The centre of the meadow is open and uncluttered so a character can stand there. Everything above the hills and bushes is NOT sky: it is one completely flat, solid, pure magenta colour (#FF00FF), perfectly even, with no clouds, no sun, no gradient. No characters, no animals, no text, no frame.
